caption: The drawing depicts a single large, cylindrical jar with a wide, slightly flared rim and two small, symmetrical handles attached to the upper sides. The jar is rendered in shades of brown, with darker shading at the base and lighter areas suggesting illumination from the upper left. The interior of the jar is visible, showing a reddish-brown tone. Centered near the top of the jar, the words “A. SEYMOUR TROY” are inscribed in blue lettering. Below the inscription, there is a decorative blue floral motif. In the upper right corner of the image, there is an inset detail, showing a close-up of one of the handles and a portion of the rim. The drawing is framed by a faint rectangular border, and the artist's signature, "N. Arnoutte," appears in the lower right corner. The background is plain, off-white with some slight discoloration near the edges.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
